objective: The new cheetahs in the game: the Cheetah and the Lightning Cheetah get the faceted models of decision 0053, and the Fire Cheetah joins as the Cheetah's legendary variant (twist strength).
acceptance_criteria: The Cheetah, the Lightning Cheetah and the Fire Cheetah load in the game with the new models, rigged and animated like every creature, in the colours of the concept cards
A legendary roll on a Cheetah hatches a Fire Cheetah; a mythic roll still hatches a Lightning Cheetah; no other odds change
The cheetahs' clips fit the new models
verification: Pending: the upload and a look in Studio.
notes: SHANNON approved the three cheetahs on 2026-11-15 and asked for them in the game. The upload runs in GitHub (environment assets), never with a key on this machine.
